q: After a fast of at least 8 hours, what plasma glucose level meets the diagnostic threshold for diabetes?
exp: Fasting plasma glucose ≥126 mg/dL is diagnostic. Below 100 mg/dL is normal, and 100-125 mg/dL is impaired fasting glucose.

evidence.quote: 2) 8시간 이상 금식 후 혈장포도당 126 mg/dL 이상 또는

q: What HbA1c value, on its own, meets the diagnostic threshold for diabetes?
exp: HbA1c ≥6.5% is diagnostic. The 5.7-6.4% band is classified as prediabetes.

evidence.quote: 1) 당화혈색소 6.5% 이상 또는

q: On a 75 g oral glucose tolerance test, what 2-hour plasma glucose level is diagnostic of diabetes?
exp: A 2-hour value ≥200 mg/dL is diabetes, while 140-199 mg/dL is impaired glucose tolerance.

evidence.quote: 3) 75 g 경구포도당부하 2시간 후 혈장포도당 200 mg/dL 이상 또는

q: Before an oral glucose tolerance test, what should a person eat for the preceding three days?
a: At least 150 g of carbohydrate a day
Fast for the whole three days
No more than 50 g of carbohydrate a day
exp: Cutting carbohydrate sharply before the test distorts the result. Usual activity is maintained with at least 150 g of carbohydrate daily, followed by a 10 to 14 hour overnight fast.

evidence.quote: 검사 전 적어도 3일 동안 평상 시의 활동을 유지하고 하루 150 g 이상의 탄수화물을 섭취한다.

q: What defines normal glucose?
a: Fasting below 90 mg/dL and a 2-hour value below 120 mg/dL
Fasting below 100 mg/dL and a 2-hour post-load value below 140 mg/dL
Fasting below 126 mg/dL and a 2-hour value below 200 mg/dL
Fasting below 110 mg/dL and a 2-hour value below 160 mg/dL
exp: Both conditions must hold. Fasting of 100-125 is impaired fasting glucose, and a 2-hour value of 140-199 is impaired glucose tolerance.

evidence.quote: 정상혈당은 8시간 이상 금식 후 혈장포도당 100 mg/dL 미만, 75 g 경구포도당부하 2시간 후 혈장포도당 140 mg/dL 미만이다.

q: Which fasting range defines impaired fasting glucose in the Korean criteria?
exp: Korea sets impaired fasting glucose at 100-125 mg/dL. Impaired glucose tolerance is a 2-hour value of 140-199 mg/dL, and the HbA1c band is 5.7-6.4%.

evidence.quote: 1) 공복혈당장애: 공복혈장포도당 100-125 mg/dL

q: Who should be screened for diabetes under the 2025 guideline?
a: All adults aged 65 years and older
All adults aged 19 and older who carry a risk factor, plus all adults aged 35 and older
All adults aged 40 and older regardless of risk factors
All adults with a family history of diabetes
exp: The 9th edition split the screening population in two. Screening starts at 19 when a risk factor is present, and at 35 for everyone else.

evidence.quote: 1) 위험인자(표 1-2.1)가 있는 19세 이상 모든 성인은 당뇨병 선별검사를 시행한다. [기타연구, 일반적권고] 2) 35세 이상 모든 성인은 당뇨병 선별검사를 시행한다. [기타연구, 일반적권고]

q: How often should an adult with a normal screening result be retested?
exp: The 9th edition asks for annual retesting even after a normal result. When one screening test lands in the prediabetes range and diabetes is suspected, a second method is added.

evidence.quote: 2) 당뇨병 선별검사 결과가 정상인 성인은 매년 재검사를 시행한다. [전문가의견, 일반적권고]

q: What is the general glycemic target for adults with type 2 diabetes?
exp: Korea sets the general type 2 target at below 6.5%. For type 1 diabetes the target is below 7.0%.

evidence.quote: 2. 2형당뇨병 성인에게서 일반적인 혈당조절 목표는 당화혈색소 6.5% 미만이다. [무작위대조군연구, 일반적권고]

q: With continuous glucose monitoring, what share of time should be spent in the 70-180 mg/dL target range?
exp: Time in range should exceed 70%, time below 70 mg/dL should stay under 4%, and time below 54 mg/dL under 1%.

evidence.quote: 5. 연속혈당측정장치를 사용하는 경우 목표혈당범위(70-180 mg/dL) 내 시간이 70%를 초과하고, 목표혈당범위 미만 … 시간을 4% 미만, 특히 54 mg/dL 미만의 저혈당 시간은 1% 미만이다.
evidence.note: 9판 PDF가 2단 조판이라 한 문장 사이에 다른 단의 글자가 끼어 있어 실제로 이어지는 조각을 " … "로 연결했어요.

q: How did the 9th edition change real-time CGM guidance for adults with type 2 diabetes on multiple daily injections or a pump?
a: It was removed from the recommendations
It moved up from a limited to a general recommendation
It was left in place for type 1 diabetes only
It moved down from a general to a limited recommendation
exp: Strengthened evidence supports continuous use more assertively. Adults with type 2 diabetes on basal insulin alone remain at a limited recommendation.

evidence.quote: 2형당뇨병 성인 중 인슐린치료를 하는 환자에서 실시간연속혈당측정기 사용은 다음 두 가지 경우로 구분하여 권고함. 다회 … 인슐린주사나 인슐린펌프를 사용하는 2형당뇨병 성인은 보강된 연구 결과들에 근거하여 실시간연속혈당측정장치를 상시 … 적으로 사용하도록 보다 적극적으로 권고하며 권고범위를 [제한적권고]에서 [일반적권고]로 상향 조정함.
evidence.note: 9판 PDF가 2단 조판이라 한 문장 사이에 다른 단의 글자가 끼어 있어 실제로 이어지는 조각을 " … "로 연결했어요.

q: How often may HbA1c be measured in an adult whose glycemic control is stable?
a: Once every three years is enough
It can be reduced to twice a year
exp: The usual interval is every 2-3 months, but stable control allows twice a year. Conversely, a medication change or a situation demanding tight control such as pregnancy calls for more frequent testing.

evidence.quote: 당화혈색소 측정은 혈당조절 상태에 따라 구분하여 ‘일반적인 당뇨병 성인은 2-3개월마다’, ‘혈당조절이 안정적인 당뇨병 성 … 인은 연 2회까지 줄여서 시행’하도록 권고함.
evidence.locator: 2025 진료지침 요약 — 4-1. 혈당조절의 모니터링 및 평가
evidence.note: 9판 PDF가 2단 조판이라 한 문장 사이에 다른 단의 글자가 끼어 있어 실제로 이어지는 조각을 " … "로 연결했어요.

q: How often should a hypoglycaemia history be reviewed in someone at risk?
a: Only when the patient brings it up
exp: The history is reviewed at every visit and assessed as needed. Knowing it in advance is what makes a prevention plan possible.

evidence.quote: 저혈당 위험이 있는 모든 개인에 대해 임상진료 시마다 저혈당 병력을 검토하고 필요할 때마다 평가해야 한다. [전문가의견, 일반적권고]

q: What glucose level defines level 2, clinically significant hypoglycemia?
exp: Level 1 is below 70 but at or above 54 mg/dL, and level 2 is below 54 mg/dL. Level 3, severe hypoglycemia, is defined by needing outside help rather than by a number.

evidence.quote: 반 … 면, 54 mg/dL 미만의 혈당은 대응조절호르몬의 분비, 저혈당 관련 자율신경증상과 같은 저혈당 방어체계의 장애가 발생할 때 … 현재는 저혈당 단계를 기존의 2단계에서 54 mg/dL 미만의 수준을 포함한 3단계로 확대하였으며,
evidence.note: 9판 PDF가 2단 조판이라 한 문장 사이에 다른 단의 글자가 끼어 있어 실제로 이어지는 조각을 " … "로 연결했어요.

q: Which hypoglycemia recommendation was newly added in the 9th edition?
a: Mandate continuous glucose monitoring for every patient
Prescribe glucagon for insulin users and make sure people around them know where it is and how to use it
Go straight to the emergency department for any hypoglycemia
exp: Family members, caregivers and school staff are now expected to know the storage location and use of glucagon. It entered as an expert-opinion recommendation.

evidence.quote: 인슐린을 사용하는 저혈당 위험이 높은 환자에게서 글루카곤을 처방하고 가 … 족, 간병인, 학교 직원 등을 포함한 주변인들이 글루카곤의 보관 위치와 사용법을 숙지하도록 [전문가의견]으로 새롭게 권 … 고안을 추가하고 권고범위는 [일반적권고]로 제시함.
evidence.note: 9판 PDF가 2단 조판이라 한 문장 사이에 다른 단의 글자가 끼어 있어 실제로 이어지는 조각을 " … "로 연결했어요.

q: How often does the 2025 guideline ask for diabetes self-management education to be repeated?
exp: The 9th edition fixed the interval at yearly. Even within a year, failing to reach targets or a self-management problem triggers a reassessment for re-education.

evidence.quote: 당뇨병 진단 후 자기관리교육을 반복적으로 시행하는 것의 중요성을 강조하기 위해 시행 주기를 ‘매년’으로 명시하고
evidence.note: 9판 PDF가 2단 조판이라 한 문장 사이에 다른 단의 글자가 끼어 있어 실제로 이어지는 조각을 " … "로 연결했어요.

q: What does the guideline ask for at the very moment diabetes is diagnosed?
a: Run complication screening first and nothing else
Actively teach lifestyle modification and self-management, then monitor that it continues
Observe for three months without acting
exp: Education comes before medication in the recommendation order. Lifestyle modification and self-management are taught at diagnosis and followed up for adherence.

evidence.quote: 당뇨병 진단 즉시 생활습관교정과 자기관리 방법을 적극적으로 교육하고 지속하도록 모니터링 한다. [무작위대조군연구, 일반적권고]

q: How did the 2025 guideline change its position on metformin?
a: The recommendation to use it first-line was deleted
exp: A network meta-analysis of 60 studies including Korean data found no clear glucose-lowering advantage, and other national guidelines no longer name it first-line.

evidence.quote: 메트포민을 1차약물로 우선 사용하도록 한 권고를 이번 개정판에서 삭제함.

q: How much aerobic exercise does the guideline recommend for people with diabetes?
a: At least 300 minutes a week, vigorous only
At least 60 minutes a week at low intensity, in a single session
At least 150 minutes a week at moderate intensity or above, spread over at least three days
exp: Aerobic exercise is spread over at least three days with never more than two consecutive rest days. Resistance exercise is done separately at least twice a week.

evidence.quote: 유산소운동은 일주일에 150분 이상, 중강도 이상으로, 적어도 3일 이상 하며, 연속해서 2일 이상 쉬지 않는다.

q: How did the 9th edition reword its carbohydrate recommendation?
a: Limit excessive carbohydrate intake, then individualise by treatment goal and preference
Fix carbohydrate at no more than 20% of total energy
Prescribe a low-carbohydrate diet to everyone
exp: The 8th edition said only "individualise", which left the direction unclear, so a clause on limiting excess was placed in front. Quality also matters, met through wholegrains, legumes, vegetables and fresh fruit.

evidence.quote: 혈당조절과 관리를 위해 과도한 탄수화물 섭취는 제한하되, 치료 목표와 선호에 따라 개별화한다.

q: What should be assessed, and how often, to screen for diabetic kidney disease?
a: Serum creatinine alone every three years
Urinary albumin excretion and estimated GFR at diagnosis and at least once a year
exp: Both urinary albumin excretion and estimated GFR are checked at diagnosis and at least annually. Albuminuria is defined as a spot urine albumin-to-creatinine ratio of 30 mg/g or above.

evidence.quote: 1. 당뇨병 진단 시 그리고 적어도 1년마다 요알부민배설량과 추정사구체여과율을 평가해야 한다.

q: How did the 9th edition split its description of starting drug therapy?
a: Start with triple therapy from the outset
Always start with monotherapy and combine after three months
Starting therapy may be single-agent or combination, and combination should be actively considered early on
exp: The existing recommendation was written out in two parts, making clear that combination deserves active consideration from early on.

evidence.quote: 1) 약물치료 시작 시 단독 또는 병용요법이 모두 가능하며, 2) 약물치료 초기 시 병용요법을 적극적으로 고려하도록 구분하
evidence.note: 9판 PDF가 2단 조판이라 한 문장 사이에 다른 단의 글자가 끼어 있어 실제로 이어지는 조각을 " … "로 연결했어요.

q: When triple oral therapy fails to reach target, what does the 9th edition text offer?
a: Stop all drugs and rely on lifestyle alone
Keep three drugs and observe for six more months
Prefer a regimen including an injectable, and consider quadruple oral therapy when an injectable is not feasible
Switch straight to intensive insulin therapy
exp: Quadruple oral therapy has established benefit from a Korean systematic review, but promoting it to a formal recommendation risked delaying early insulin.

evidence.quote: 주사제 기반의 치료가 어려운 경우에는 4제병용요법을 고려할 수 있다

q: Which drug class is preferred for type 2 diabetes with heart failure?
a: An SGLT2 inhibitor with proven heart failure benefit
exp: With heart failure present, an SGLT2 inhibitor comes first regardless of HbA1c and is continued unless there is a contraindication or adverse effect.

evidence.quote: 8. 심부전을 동반한 경우 심부전이익이 입증된 SGLT2억제제를 당화혈색소 수치와 무관하게 우선 사용하고 금기나 부 … 작용이 없는 한 유지한다. [무작위대조군연구, 일반적권고]
evidence.note: 9판 PDF가 2단 조판이라 한 문장 사이에 다른 단의 글자가 끼어 있어 실제로 이어지는 조각을 " … "로 연결했어요.

q: Which drug class comes first when albuminuria is present or estimated GFR has fallen?
a: An SGLT2 inhibitor with proven kidney benefit
exp: When kidney markers have worsened, an SGLT2 inhibitor with proven renal benefit comes first regardless of HbA1c.

evidence.quote: 9. 알부민뇨가 있거나 추정사구체여과율이 감소한 경우 신장이익이 입증된 SGLT2억제제를 당화혈색소 수치와 무관하 … 게 우선 사용하고 금기나 부작용이 없는 한 유지한다. [무작위대조군연구, 일반적권고]
evidence.note: 9판 PDF가 2단 조판이라 한 문장 사이에 다른 단의 글자가 끼어 있어 실제로 이어지는 조각을 " … "로 연결했어요.

q: When an injectable-based combination is considered, which agent comes first?
a: Basal insulin ahead of a GLP-1 receptor agonist
A GLP-1 receptor agonist ahead of basal insulin
exp: A GLP-1 receptor agonist is preferred over basal insulin. If either alone falls short, the two are combined.

evidence.quote: 1) 주사제 기반의 병용요법을 고려할 때 기저인슐린보다 GLP-1수용체작용제를 우선한다. [무작위대조군연구, 일반적권고]

q: How did the 9th edition change the trigger for starting insulin?
a: The HbA1c 9% threshold was dropped in favour of hyperglycaemia with catabolic symptoms
Insulin is now started at diagnosis
The 9% threshold was kept as is
exp: The 9% threshold was judged weak in evidence and out of step with practice. Insulin is indicated when hyperglycaemia comes with catabolic symptoms.

evidence.quote: 권고문을 수정하여 ‘과이화작용 증상(체중 감소, 다음, 다뇨 등의 증상)과 동반된 고혈당의 경우 인슐린치료를 … 시 … 행한다’로 수정된 권고안을 [전문가의견, 일반적권고]로 제시함.
evidence.note: 9판 PDF가 2단 조판이라 한 문장 사이에 다른 단의 글자가 끼어 있어 실제로 이어지는 조각을 " … "로 연결했어요.

q: As of 2022, what share of Korean adults aged 30 and over had diabetes?
src: Bae, J. H., Han, K.-D., Ko, S.-H., Yang, Y. S., Choi, J. H., Choi, K. M., Kwon, H.-S., & Won, K. C. (2025). Diabetes fact sheet in Korea 2024. Diabetes & Metabolism Journal, 49(1), 24-33. https://doi.org/10.4093/dmj.2024.0818
exp: About 1 in 7 adults aged 30 and over has diabetes. Among those aged 65 and over the figure rises to 3 in 10, or 28.0%.

evidence.quote: As of 2022, 1 in 7 adults aged ≥30 years (14.8%) had diabetes.

q: In 2021-2022, what share of Korean adults with diabetes reached an HbA1c below 6.5%?
src: Bae, J. H., Han, K.-D., Ko, S.-H., Yang, Y. S., Choi, J. H., Choi, K. M., Kwon, H.-S., & Won, K. C. (2025). Diabetes fact sheet in Korea 2024. Diabetes & Metabolism Journal, 49(1), 24-33. https://doi.org/10.4093/dmj.2024.0818
exp: Awareness reached 74.7% and treatment 70.9%, but the control rate stopped at 32.4%. The gap between knowing and reaching target is wide.

evidence.quote: Control rate: Percentage of people achieving HbA1c <6.5% among people with diabetes (based on HbA1c)
evidence.locator: Management of diabetes (2021-2022) — Total (≥30 years old) 32.4

q: How many Korean adults aged 30 and over are estimated to have prediabetes?
src: Bae, J. H., Han, K.-D., Ko, S.-H., Yang, Y. S., Choi, J. H., Choi, K. M., Kwon, H.-S., & Won, K. C. (2025). Diabetes fact sheet in Korea 2024. Diabetes & Metabolism Journal, 49(1), 24-33. https://doi.org/10.4093/dmj.2024.0818
exp: Among adults aged 30 and over, 5.33 million have diabetes and 14.0 million have prediabetes, nearly three times as many.

evidence.quote: Among adults aged ≥30 years, an estimated 14.0 million people have prediabetes.

q: In 2021-2022, what were the awareness and treatment rates among Korean adults with diabetes?
src: Bae, J. H., Han, K.-D., Ko, S.-H., Yang, Y. S., Choi, J. H., Choi, K. M., Kwon, H.-S., & Won, K. C. (2025). Diabetes fact sheet in Korea 2024. Diabetes & Metabolism Journal, 49(1), 24-33. https://doi.org/10.4093/dmj.2024.0818
exp: Awareness and treatment have climbed into the seventies while control sits at 32.4%. What happens after diagnosis and prescription is the gap.

evidence.quote: Compared with 2019–2020, the 2021–2022 survey showed increases in diabetes awareness, treatment, and control rates.
evidence.locator: Management of diabetes (2021-2022) — Total (≥30 years old) 74.7 / 70.9 / 32.4

q: What share of Korean adults aged 65 and over has diabetes?
src: Bae, J. H., Han, K.-D., Ko, S.-H., Yang, Y. S., Choi, J. H., Choi, K. M., Kwon, H.-S., & Won, K. C. (2025). Diabetes fact sheet in Korea 2024. Diabetes & Metabolism Journal, 49(1), 24-33. https://doi.org/10.4093/dmj.2024.0818
exp: The figure for all adults over 30 is 14.8%, so 28.0% at 65 and over is nearly double. That is why the 2024 fact sheet made older adults a focus.

evidence.quote: Among adults aged ≥65 years, 3 in 10 (28.0%) had diabetes.
